description: This file defines CSS styles and variables for managing themes in a responsive tic-tac-toe application, including different colors for light and dark themes.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application styling with center alignment and responsive background color based on theme.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styling for the application header, with flex properties for centering and background color transitions.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Styling for the application logo, including size and animation properties.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styles for links in the application, including color transitions.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the theme toggle button, including positioning, background color, and hover effects.
